Complete figure with plain unmarked shoes. No speech balloons or symbols. A smiling adult man in an olive shirt and beige trousers addresses the viewer, pointing gently outward with his index finger. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
